name: root-crate-artifacts-split
body: The `artifacts` module is organized as `src/artifacts/db.rs`, `src/artifacts/merge.rs`, and `src/artifacts/project.rs` under `src/artifacts/mod.rs`. `ParsedArgs` and `parse_args` are declared in `mod.rs`, and the module FQN `rust.apg.artifacts` anchors the submodules. `ArtifactDb` is declared in `db.rs`, so its methods render under `rust.apg.artifacts.db.ArtifactDb.*`, though its impl blocks span `db.rs`, `merge.rs`, and `project.rs`; the test module is `rust.apg.artifacts.tests`.
